scope: Post-hoc descriptive review prompted by detected shared-node workload changes; not a new experiment or a preregistered hypothesis test.
primary_analysis: Retains all 320 completed intervals; does not selectively remove measured values.
causal_limit: Block 5 coincided with background workload changes. Five-block confidence intervals do not isolate transport causality or quantify that confounding.
comparison: Geometric paired ratios over blocks 1-4 versus block 5, without additional confidence intervals.
